description: A function from a partial order to a preorder preserving and reflecting comparisons is an order embedding, in particular injective.
signature:
OrderEmbedding.ofMapLEIff.{u_6, u_7} {α : Type u_6} {β : Type u_7} [PartialOrder α] [Preorder β] (f : α → β)
  (hf : ∀ (a b : α), f a ≤ f b ↔ a ≤ b) : α ↪o β
